transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Honestly, I'm really struggling because I keep eating these massive amounts of food, way more than anyone normally would. It feels like I've completely lost control over my eating, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or the misuse of laxatives?
No, I don't do anything like that at all. I have never tried to throw up, use laxatives, or exercise to make up for the food I ate.

latest_inference.note: The patient explicitly denied compensatory behaviors such as purging, laxative use, or excessive exercise. These behaviors are the defining clinical distinction between Bulimia Nervosa and Binge-Eating Disorder. Since the patient reports recurrent binge eating without compensatory behaviors, Binge-Eating Disorder is the appropriate diagnosis.
